Instead of starting every project from scratch, you can use prompts, images, references, and AI-powered tools to explore ideas and produce finished designs faster.</p></details><details><summary>What is an AI design generator?</summary><p>An AI design generator turns text prompts, images, and other references into creative visual content, including images, videos, product visuals, advertisements, branding concepts, and more.</p></details><details><summary>What can I create with AI design?</summary><p>You can create AI images, videos, product advertisements, packaging designs, social media content, brand visuals, illustrations, storyboards, and other creative assets.</p></details><details><summary>How does AI design work?</summary><p>Start with an idea, prompt, image, or reference. AI analyzes your input and generates or transforms the content based on your instructions, allowing you to refine and explore different creative directions.</p></details><details><summary>Who can use AI design tools?</summary><p>AI design tools are useful for creators, designers, marketers, businesses, and anyone who wants to create visual content. You don&#x27;t need advanced design or editing skills to get started.</p></details><details><summary>Can AI design tools create commercial content?</summary><p>Yes. AI design tools can help create marketing visuals, product advertisements, social media content, branding materials, and other commercial creative assets. Always make sure your inputs, references, and generated content comply with applicable licensing requirements.</p></details><details><summary>What makes MiniMax Design different from other AI design tools?</summary><p>MiniMax Design brings multiple AI models, creative tools, and AI skills into one workspace. You can generate, edit, and refine images and videos while using different models and workflows without switching between multiple tools.</p></details><details><summary>How can I edit an existing photo for a design?</summary><p>Use the <a class="tool-page__heading-link" href="/tools/ai-photo-editor">AI Photo Editor</a> to start from a portrait, product shot, or another existing photo. Describe what to change, refine the result with follow-up instructions, and continue developing it into a design.</p></details></div></div></section></main><footer class="footer"><div
